name: Bannerbear
description:
This connector helps you create images and videos based on templates you define. If you have a design you reuse often or want to automate, create the template in Bannerbear and use this connector to generate variations from the template (change text, change images etc) in your chats. 

Images and video generated are deterministic, not AI.

You can use this to

- generate templated images for social
- generate templated PDF documents for sales
- generate templated videos for social / sales 

You also have access to Bannerbear workflows in chats, allowing you to run media editing workflows (resizing, overlaying videos etc).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bannerbear to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bannerbear to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bannerbear.com/?chat=true. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bannerbear MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bannerbear lists 17 MCP tools, including create_batch, delete_template, generate_image, get_account, get_batch, get_image, get_layer_schema, get_template, get_workflow, get_workflow_run, list_batches, and list_images.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bannerbear?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bannerbear in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Bannerbear requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bannerbear is developed by Bannerbear. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
